description: Scaffold the React + Vite + Tailwind CSS project with all configuration, dependencies (framer-motion, react-icons, react-intersection-observer), and create the complete component structure with Header, Hero, Services, Process, Portfolio, Testimonials, Pricing, Contact, and Footer components. Set up the dark theme color palette via CSS variables and Tailwind config.
steps: Create the project using Vite React-TS template: run `npm create vite@latest . -- --template react-ts` in /projects/sandbox/My-saas (use --force or remove .git temporarily if needed, then restore)
Install Tailwind CSS v3 with PostCSS and Autoprefixer: `npm install -D tailwindcss postcss autoprefixer` and init with `npx tailwindcss init -p`
Install animation and utility libraries: `npm install framer-motion react-intersection-observer react-icons`
Configure tailwind.config.js with custom colors (background: #0a0a0f, surface: #12121a, accent gradients purple/cyan), extended border-radius (24px, 40px), and font families (Inter)
Set up src/index.css with Tailwind directives (@tailwind base/components/utilities), CSS variables for the color palette, smooth scroll, and glassmorphism utility classes
Create src/App.tsx that imports and renders all section components in order: Header, Hero, Services, Process, Portfolio, Testimonials, Pricing, Contact, Footer
Create a stub for each component file (Header.tsx, Hero.tsx, Services.tsx, Process.tsx, Portfolio.tsx, Testimonials.tsx, Pricing.tsx, Contact.tsx, Footer.tsx) so the app compiles
Update index.html with Inter font import from Google Fonts and proper meta tags
Verify `npm run build` succeeds with no errors
Create a git branch feature/saas-landing-page and commit the scaffolding
acceptance_criteria: npm run build succeeds without errors
All component files exist in src/components/
Tailwind is configured with custom dark theme colors
CSS variables define the color palette
The project is on feature/saas-landing-page branch with initial commit
